## Observations (recorded only; no action taken, per PO-008 §7)

1. **Mixed time formats.** Start Time prints as "6:32 PM" and Finish Time as "16:00". Start Time is the read-only creation time, formatted for 12-hour display; Finish Time is printed as entered. On this test record, the finish time is also earlier than the start time. This existed before the SIL work and was not changed in A-4.
2. **Selections are recorded, not completeness.** The PDF prints the controls the user selected for each step. For example, step 2 (hydraulic bolt tensioner) prints 2 controls. This record does not show whether that matches the controls the app offered for that step.
3. **Hazard checklist not linked to task steps.** The hazard checklist on page 2 is filled in separately from the task steps. For example, Hot Work / Fire Hazard and Fall Potential are unchecked even though steps 3 and 6 include hot work and fall hazards. This is existing behavior, and the app has no automatic link between the two.
